FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Prospect Intelligence AI Tool
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Prospect Intelligence BDE Tool is a B2B automation tool designed to streamline prospecting for my company’s Business Development Executive (BDE) team. Users can log in and paste a LinkedIn or company About Us URL to scrape and clean data, extract key insights, and generate personalized outreach emails. Built with React, Node.js, Python, and MySQL, it uses Express, Playwright, Django, and Redux for scraping, backend logic, and frontend state management. The tool reduced manual research time, helping BDEs focus on outreach. Within 3 months, it boosted prospect engagement and sales collaboration by 8%, making it a scalable B2B growth solution.
